svg.title: The actual completed lisse coefficient target
svg.desc: Positive genus: finite matrix coefficients provide cofree injectives; additive translation makes top cohomology vanish and a three-column resolution proves full derived-heart effectivity. Projective line: the unit endomorphism algebra has an even degree-two generator, while completion is all modules over a free associative degree-minus-one generator. Its nonzero Laurent module is invisible to the compact unit. The actual DG coefficient model gives the entire restricted projective-line spectral functor, including framed negative-coefficient loops. The general-curve restricted nilpotent projector remains unproved.
svg.text: The actual completed lisse coefficient target
Smooth projective complex curve; every unbounded object and full DG coefficient action.
1. Positive genus: cofree acyclicity and full effectivity — RSC.1–RSC.14
C_Γ = finite matrix coefficients; C_Γ ⊗ W is an injective ind-connection.
Tℓ = ℓ + c, c ≠ 0; D = log T; Dℓ = c; DS(f) = f.
The finite integration sum makes T − 1 surjective, so Hom_Γ(C_Γ, C) = 0.
Proper trace duality gives H²_dR(C_Γ) = 0; injectivity gives H¹ = 0.
Every Ext² class is effaced in a finite connection; injective dimension is ≤ 2.
Three resolution columns prove Q_X = I_X = D(Ind Conn_f(X)), with full tensor.
2. The projective-line DG unit and its exact resolution — RSC.15–RSC.22
Every finite connection is trivial, but End(1) = E = C[η]/(η²), |η| = 2.
B = T_C(C[1]) is free ASSOCIATIVE: |u| = −1, du = 0, u² ≠ 0.
Δu = u ⊗ 1 + 1 ⊗ u; the tensor uses this primitive Hopf action.
RHom_B(C, C) ≃ E; the primitive diagonal of τ retains the unit-cup coherences.
I_(P¹) ≃ Mod_E ≃ Loc_(Mod_B)(C) = {M : M[u⁻²] = 0}.
3. The full completion adds genuine objects — RSC.23–RSC.26
I_(P¹)
full inclusion
Q_(P¹) = Mod_B
All bounded-below B-modules are u²-torsion; their Postnikov limit gives Mod_B.
L = B[u⁻²] ≠ 0, RHom_B(C, L) = 0; L is outside the finite-lisse ind-category.
L_n = τ^(≥−n)L lies in I_(P¹); its completed limit is L.
RHom_B(C, L_n) = C[n], and the next quotient kills its kernel class u^n.
The unit C is compact and does not generate. Free B is a compact generator.
4. Entire DG coefficients and the actual P¹ restricted functor — RSC.27–RSC.30
For any connective A, including unbounded negative degrees: Q_(P¹,A) = Mod_(A⊗B).
Framed tensor-compatible u-actions are closed α ∈ (h ⊗ A)^(−1), with all paths.
Z_H^restr(P¹) ≃ [Spec Sym(h∨[1]) / H], for every connected reductive H.
For H = G_m: B G_m × Spec C[ξ], |ξ| = −1, ξ² = 0, dξ = 0.
ξ is a COMMUTATIVE coordinate. It does not impose u² = 0 on B.
The quotient and free-generator mapping bars retain every higher DG comparison.
5. Ordinary rank-one variation and a higher coefficient loop — RSC.31–RSC.38
Original-field local finiteness ⇔ the monodromy subalgebra A_0 ⊂ A is finite-dimensional.
On a nonempty connected base: a_γ = χ(γ)(1 + n_γ), χ fixed, all n_γ in one nilpotent ideal.
For A = C[δ]/(δ²), |δ| = −2: the framed P¹ point is unique, but π_1 = hδ.
A loop sends λ to λ(a)δ dt. Its total degree is −1 and both endpoints are zero.
The general restricted nilpotent programme remains required
Restricted spectral atlas, localization and Hecke action; the nilpotent Beilinson projector,
its support image and regularity; geometric ground fields, tempered and microlocal proofs.
